assets.title: Outdoor Scouting Route & Representative Sampling
assets.purpose: Show a repeatable edge/interior route, plant/sample-unit selection, canopy positions and trap locations so observations can be compared across dates.
assets.diagnosticUse: Prevents a single convenient plant or leaf from representing the whole crop.

assets.title: Pest, Beneficial or Neutral? Outdoor Arthropod Reference
assets.purpose: Show representative pest groups alongside common beneficial predators/parasitoid evidence and neutral visitors, with life-stage cues.
assets.diagnosticUse: Reduces indiscriminate 'bug = pest' decisions and directs the user to organism identity plus damage evidence.

assets.title: Outdoor Feeding-Damage Look-Alikes
assets.purpose: Compare stippling, silvery scraping, piercing-sucking distortion, chewing, mines/webbing and physical/weather injury on cannabis leaves.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps separate mites/thrips/sap feeders/chewers from hail, abrasion or nutrient-type spotting by pairing damage with next evidence to inspect.

assets.title: Caterpillar & Flower Damage — Frass, Entry & Internal Injury
assets.purpose: Show caterpillar presence, frass, entry sites, internal feeding and secondary flower damage in realistic outdoor flowers.
assets.diagnosticUse: Helps distinguish insect-driven flower browning/decay from primary moisture-driven rot or physical injury.

assets.title: Wildlife Damage Signatures
assets.purpose: Compare deer-type tearing/browse, rabbit or rodent clipping/gnawing, bird flower/seed disturbance, digging and trampling with insect/weather look-alikes.
assets.diagnosticUse: Uses damage height, edge shape, tracks/scat/camera evidence and spatial pattern instead of guessing animal identity from one bite.

assets.title: Wildlife Exclusion Audit — Find the Breach
assets.purpose: Show fencing, gates, mesh/netting where appropriate, ground gaps, undermining, overhead access and storm-damaged breach points.
assets.diagnosticUse: Connects new wildlife damage to actual access points and follow-up after repairs instead of escalating harmful control methods.
